scope: Finite full-support exact coupling repair, conservative cost and dual-feasibility certificate; eight public CPU cases and curated lexical retrieval only; no model/GPU/Lean/token/e2e gains

implementation.procedure: Review row then column downward scaling and rank-one completion; general conservation proof and dual shift
implementation.acceptance: Correct nonnegative normalized marginals and zero deficit branch; no sparse-mask/float certificate claim

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent closed-form T1-T8 and counterexample inspection, different reference from producer
reference_boundary.acceptance: Eight frozen expected cases including zero/oversize/invalid/forbidden edge/dual violation

data_integrity.procedure: Hash original corpus/holdout; check mirrored cards and frozen inputs
data_integrity.acceptance: Original paths unchanged; six query hits, full three-card closure <=22000 chars; no holdout content read

numerical_sanity.procedure: Fraction exact signs/row/column invariants, mass and raw versus true bound; same-unit force
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Exact repaired marginals; error<=U<=rawcost+D*tau, L<=opt<=U; negative inputs refused

measurement_validity.procedure: Diagnostic times/chars only; model and performance unavailable
measurement_validity.acceptance: N/A for performance predeclared; no speed/token/model claims

reproducibility.procedure: Separate output replay, independent reference,34 knowledge regressions
